  1. Students must earn a \"C-\" grade or higher in all courses and prerequisite courses required in the major, with the exception of CHEM 1A, which requires a \"C\" grade or higher.
  2. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Chemistry is compatible with the B.A. in Chemistry - Biochemistry concentration at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a \"C\" or better.
  3. Students pursuing a Chemistry degree are strongly encouraged to complete as much of the lower-division science and math curriculum as possible. In particular, the department advises Chemistry majors to complete: CHEM 1A, CHEM 1B, MATH 30, MATH 31, PHYS 5A, and PHYS 5B (or PHYS 11A, PHYS 11B, and PHYS 11C) prior to transfer.
  4. Students are strongly advised to complete Calculus and Physics prior to transfer as these courses are prerequisites to Physical Chemistry (a required upper-division course for all Chemistry majors).
  5. Students pursuing the B.A. in Chemistry with a concentration in Biochemistry should complete courses equivalent to BIO 1 and 2 prior to transfer.
  6. English 20, or an approved second semester composition course, is a prerequisite for all upper-division laboratories. It is recommended students complete this course prior to transfer.
  7. For additional information, please visit: Department of Chemistry.
